title: Active capability probes lack a plugin-side request-count cap
description: The tool schema accepts a levels array without maxItems, preserves duplicate recognized values, and sends one provider request per surviving level plus a negative control. Dispatcher argument bounds and provider quotas are not established.
claimed_root_cause: The plugin accepts model-controlled active-probe levels without truncation/deduplication and issues a request for each; any outer request-count cap is unknown.

trace.description: The levels argument is an array without a visible maximum item count.
A nonempty supplied levels array is retained.
The probe sends one request for each accepted level.

evidence.description: Filtering recognized levels does not remove duplicate entries.
Each retained entry triggers a separate request.
The local gate requires active=true and confirm=true.

blockers: The shipped dispatcher may cap argument cardinality or require approval bound to final arguments; that implementation is not in this checkout.
Provider billing and quota limits are outside this source review; no provider-backed request was made.

validation_plan.local: In a bounded isolated fixture, use duplicate recognized levels and fake fetch/provider configuration, then count fake requests through the registered tool. Inspect shipped dispatcher argument limits without contacting a provider.
validation_plan.deployment: Have the owner inspect dispatcher argument/approval limits and configured route quotas without sending probe traffic.
